title_hi: चिंटू और मिठू का जादुई म्यूजिकल चेयर
title_en: Chintu and Mithu's Musical Chairs Magic
description: Watch Chintu the elephant and Mithu the parrot play a fun musical chairs game with animal sounds. Perfect for toddlers to learn animal noises and have fun! #Shorts #KidsRhymes #Cartoon
learning: Teaches animal sound identification and rhythm through interactive play.

scenes.text: Arrey! Musical chairs par kaun baitha hai?
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16, 3D render of a cute orange baby elephant Chintu and green parrot Mithu looking confused at a spinning musical chair, bright colorful playroom background, high detail, vibrant.

scenes.text: Music starts, tap tap tap! Let's go!
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16, Chintu the elephant dancing rhythmically while wiggling his ears, bright yellow floor, soft studio lighting, cute expression.

scenes.text: Mithu udta hai, peep peep peep!
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16, Mithu the green parrot with a red cap flapping wings around a chair, flying motion blur, sparkling magical particles around him.
Vertical 9:16, Chintu the elephant stomping his feet excitedly in a circle, dust particles floating, cheerful atmosphere, 3D CGI.

scenes.text: Music stops! Baitho, sit down fast!
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16, a single chair in the middle, Chintu and Mithu diving towards the chair with surprised funny faces, high-quality 3D render.
Vertical 9:16, Chintu sitting triumphantly on the chair, Mithu laughing beside him, confetti falling, bright celebration.

scenes.text: Haha! Sab saath milkar dance karo!
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16, Chintu and Mithu high-fiving and dancing together, wide shot, joy and excitement, vibrant colors.

scenes.text: Ruko! Magic chair phir se bajne wali hai...
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16, close up on Chintu and Mithu winking at the camera, a musical chair in the background starting to glow, loop transition ready.
